name: Chicken Supreme
description: A hearty chicken dish with tomatoes, herbs, and cheese, baked to perfection and served over rice or pasta.

recipeInstructions.text: Boil the chicken breasts in a separate container until pink is gone (about 1/4 of the way cooked).
In a baking or roasting pan, mix together the tomato ingredients (stewed tomatoes, green pepper, onion, basil, oregano, garlic).
Place the partially cooked chicken breasts in the bottom of the pan.
Sprinkle spices over the chicken breasts.
Pour the remaining tomato mixture on top of the chicken breasts.
Cover and bake at 350°F for approximately ½ hour.
Sprinkle grated cheese on top, cover, and bake for an additional 15 minutes.
Serve over rice or pasta.

keywords: chicken supreme, baked chicken, Italian-style chicken

_similar.name: Favourite Chicken
_similar.description: A simple and satisfying chicken dish baked with cheddar cheese, mushroom soup, and garlic.
recipeIngredient: 1 can cheddar cheese soup (or other soup to taste)

recipeInstructions.text: Wash and pat dry chicken breasts.
Combine cheddar cheese soup, mushroom soup, and garlic powder. Mix well.
Place chicken in a 9x11 inch baking dish. Pour soup mixture over chicken.
Top with grated cheese and sliced mushrooms.
Bake at 350°F for about 1 hour for 4 pieces or 1½ hours for 6 pieces.
Check to ensure chicken is cooked through, as oven temperatures may vary.

_similar.keywords: baked chicken, cheddar cheese, mushroom soup, comfort food

_similar.name: Mock Cabbage Rolls
_similar.description: A casserole-style dish mimicking cabbage rolls, featuring a savory ground beef and rice mixture layered over shredded cabbage and topped with cheddar cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Brown hamburger with chopped onion, salt, pepper, mushrooms, seasoning salt, onion powder, and garlic salt in a skillet.
Add rice, tomatoes, and soup to the browned hamburger mixture; mix well.
Shred cabbage and place in the bottom of a large casserole dish.
Place the hamburger mixture on top of the cabbage layer.
Cover and bake in a preheated 350°F oven for 30 minutes.
Remove from oven, sprinkle cheddar cheese on top, cover, and return to oven for an additional 15 to 30 minutes, or until cabbage is cooked and cheese is melted.

_similar.keywords: mock cabbage rolls, casserole, cheesy cabbage

_similar.name: Macaroni Casserole
_similar.description: A comforting macaroni and meat casserole topped with cheese and baked until golden.
recipeIngredient: 1 to 2 cups grated cheese (e.g., cheddar, mozzarella, Monterey Jack)

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the macaroni, drain and set aside.
Brown hamburger, adding onions, green pepper and mushrooms.
Add the spices, ketchup and tomatoes. Reduce heat and simmer.
Place the macaroni and meat mixture in a large casserole dish and mix.
Spoon the mushroom soup across the top, covering the casserole.
Sprinkle the cheese on top.
Cover and bake in 350°F oven for ½ hour.

_similar.keywords: macaroni casserole, cheesy pasta bake, comfort food

_similar.name: Artichoke Appetizer
_similar.description: A warm, cheesy artichoke appetizer perfect for serving with bread or crackers.

recipeInstructions.text: Drain artichoke hearts.
Combine artichoke hearts with cheese, mayonnaise, garlic salt, and green onion in a casserole dish.
Sprinkle parsley over the top.
Bake at 350°F for 25 to 30 minutes.
Serve with bread or crackers.

_similar.keywords: artichoke appetizer, cheesy dip, party snack

_similar.name: Spaghetti Sauce
_similar.description: A hearty spaghetti sauce made with ground hamburger, vegetables, and a blend of herbs and spices.

recipeInstructions.text: Saute the onion, celery, and garlic until tender.
Add the ground hamburger and brown.
Add the remaining ingredients and simmer for several hours.

_similar.keywords: spaghetti sauce, homemade sauce, Italian-American cuisine
